The '''Heater''' is a [[Tools|tool]] used to keep [[animals]] warm and happy during the [[winter]]. It can be purchased from [[Marnie]] for {{Price|2000}}.  A heater is the reward for completing the {{Bundle|fodder||y}}.

A heater has an effect on animal '''[[Animals#Mood|Mood]]''' (which is different than [[Animals#Friendship|Friendship]]) during the Winter when an animal is inside a barn or coop past 6PM, and the animal has 150 mood or above. Only a single heater is required to have an effect, additional heaters provide no additional benefit.

If the animal is able to enter a building with a heater without being trapped outside, they will gain 10 mood every 10 in-game minutes past 6PM, up to the maximum value of 255, or until the Farmer goes to sleep.
